# apicurio_global_rule (Resource)

A registry-wide rule, applied to every artifact that has no rule of the same type on its group or on itself. One resource per rule type; a rule configured outside Terraform can be imported. On a secured registry global rules need the admin role. Rules are applied when a version is created and when a draft leaves `DRAFT`, never to existing versions. See the provider documentation for the precedence of rules and their maturity per artifact type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Registry-wide defaults: every artifact without a rule of the same type on
# its group or on itself gets these. Needs the admin role on a secured registry.
resource "apicurio_global_rule" "validity" {
  rule_type = "VALIDITY"
  config    = "FULL"
}

resource "apicurio_global_rule" "compatibility" {
  rule_type = "COMPATIBILITY"
  config    = "BACKWARD"
}

resource "apicurio_global_rule" "integrity" {
  rule_type = "INTEGRITY"
  config    = "REFS_EXIST,NO_DUPLICATES"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Configuration of the rule, validated against `rule_type`: `VALIDITY` takes `NONE`, `SYNTAX_ONLY` or `FULL`; `COMPATIBILITY` takes `NONE`, `BACKWARD`, `BACKWARD_TRANSITIVE`, `FORWARD`, `FORWARD_TRANSITIVE`, `FULL` or `FULL_TRANSITIVE`; `INTEGRITY` takes a comma-separated set of `REFS_EXIST`, `NO_DUPLICATES`, `NO_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES` and `ALL_REFS_MAPPED`, or `FULL` or `NONE` alone. Changed in place.
- `rule_type` (String) `VALIDITY`, `COMPATIBILITY` or `INTEGRITY`. Changing it replaces the rule.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `rule_type`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Global rules are imported by rule type.
terraform import apicurio_global_rule.validity VALIDITY
```
